# uptimekuma_notification_openwa (Resource)

OpenWA (self-hosted WhatsApp gateway) notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send the default message to a list of WhatsApp chats.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_openwa" "example" {
  name       = "OpenWA Notifications"
  api_url    = "http://localhost:2785/"
  api_key    = "your-openwa-api-key"
  session    = "default"
  chat_id    = "00117612345678@c.us,123456789012345678@g.us,1234567890@lid"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

# Send a custom message rendered from a template.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_openwa" "custom_message" {
  name               = "OpenWA Custom Message"
  api_url            = "http://localhost:2785/"
  api_key            = "your-openwa-api-key"
  session            = "default"
  chat_id            = "00117612345678@c.us"
  use_custom_message = true
  custom_message     = "{{ name }} is {{ status }}: {{ msg }}"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change api_key_wo_version whenever the API key changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_openwa" "write_only" {
  name = "OpenWA with a write-only API key"

  api_url = "http://localhost:2785/"
  session = "default"
  chat_id = "00117612345678@c.us"

  api_key_wo         = "your-openwa-api-key"
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_url` (String) Base URL of the OpenWA gateway (e.g., `http://localhost:2785/`). Uptime Kuma strips trailing slashes when sending. The value is stored verbatim.
- `chat_id` (String) Comma-separated list of WhatsApp chat IDs (e.g., `00117612345678@c.us,123456789012345678@g.us,1234567890@lid`). Uptime Kuma trims each entry and drops empty ones. Sending fails if no chat ID remains.
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `session` (String) Name of the OpenWA session. Uptime Kuma URL-encodes it into the request path.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key sent as `X-Api-Key` header to the OpenWA gateway. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) API key sent as `X-Api-Key` header to the OpenWA gateway, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `custom_message` (String) Custom message template. Uptime Kuma only renders it if `use_custom_message` is `true` and the trimmed template is not empty, otherwise it sends the default message.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `use_custom_message` (Boolean) If `true`, render `custom_message` instead of sending the default message (see `custom_message`). If `false` or unset, Uptime Kuma sends the default message.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
